data.name: AppTitle
data.comment: The name of the app; the title of the control window.

data.name: LensLabel
data.comment: Label beside the on/off switch.

data.name: LensOn
data.comment: Text on the lens switch while the lens is on.

data.name: LensOff
data.comment: Text on the lens switch while the lens is off.

data.name: LensSwitchName
data.comment: Name of the lens switch for screen readers.

data.name: ThemeLabel
data.comment: Label beside the theme list; also its name for screen readers.

data.name: BaseDark
data.comment: Group heading in the theme list.

data.name: BaseLight
data.comment: Group heading in the theme list.

data.name: BaseKeep
data.comment: Group heading in the theme list.

data.name: FillScreen
data.comment: Button: the lens covers the whole monitor it is mostly on; again to restore.

data.name: EditMode
data.comment: Button: the lens can be moved and resized.

data.name: EditModeHelp
data.value: In edit mode, drag the lens to move it and drag an edge to resize it. Arrow keys move, Shift with arrow keys resizes, Enter or Esc locks it again.
data.comment: Help text under the two buttons.

data.name: StatusLabel
data.comment: Name of the status line for screen readers.

data.name: StatusOff
data.comment: Status: the lens is off.

data.name: StatusLive
data.comment: Status: the lens shows the recoloured screen. {0} is the delay in milliseconds.

data.name: StatusLiveReduced
data.comment: Status: the lens runs slower than its standard budget.

data.name: StatusHolding
data.comment: Status: the lens shows the plain page colour.

data.name: StatusEditing
data.comment: Status while the lens is in edit mode. {0} is the live status text.

data.name: SlowStrongSharpen
data.value: Strong sharpen costs the most time. Nothing has been switched off.
data.comment: Shown with "Live, reduced speed".

data.name: SlowLocalContrast
data.value: Local contrast costs the most time. Nothing has been switched off.
data.comment: Shown with "Live, reduced speed".

data.name: SlowCpuRendering
data.value: The lens is drawn by the processor, because this computer has no usable graphics processor.
data.comment: Shown with "Live, reduced speed" on a machine without a GPU.

data.name: FrameRate
data.comment: Frame-rate read-out. {0} is a whole number.

data.name: FrameRateName
data.comment: Name of the frame-rate read-out for screen readers.

data.name: SoftwareRendering
data.value: No usable graphics processor was found. The lens is drawn by the processor and may be slower.
data.comment: Note shown when rendering runs on the CPU.

data.name: DevModeNote
data.value: Development mode is for stepping through code with a debugger. The lens is not kept on top and covers at most a quarter of the screen. To use the lens, start ThemeLens without --dev.
data.comment: Shown prominently at the top of the control window when the app was started with --dev.

data.name: DevModeHeading
data.comment: Heading of the development mode notice in the control window.

data.name: HandleTextDev
data.value: Lens: {0} (development mode, not kept on top)
data.comment: Text on the handle of the lens when the app was started with --dev. {0} is the name of the theme.

data.name: PatternNote
data.value: Test pattern: the lens shows a built-in picture, not the screen.
data.comment: Note shown when the app was started with --source pattern.

data.name: CaptureNote
data.value: Screenshots and screen sharing show the original screen, not the lens.
data.comment: A side effect users should know about.

data.name: ShortcutsHeading
data.comment: Heading above the list of shortcuts.

data.name: ShortcutGesture
data.comment: A shortcut as shown to the user. {0} is the letter key.

data.name: ShortcutNotSet
data.comment: Shown for a shortcut that Windows or another app already owns.

data.name: ShortcutRowName
data.comment: How a shortcut row is read out. {0} is the action, {1} the keys or "not set".

data.name: AdjustHeading
data.comment: Heading above the sliders in the control window.

data.name: BrightnessLabel
data.comment: Label of the slider that limits how bright anything in the lens may be.

data.name: WarmthLabel
data.comment: Label of the slider that removes blue light.

data.name: ContrastLabel
data.comment: Label of the contrast slider.

data.name: SharpenLabel
data.comment: Label of the sharpen slider.

data.name: KeepBackgroundLabel
data.comment: Label of the list that chooses how strictly large areas are held to the theme's background.

data.name: KeepStrict
data.comment: Keep background: every large area that differs from the page becomes the page colour.

data.name: KeepBalanced
data.comment: Keep background: areas that look like photographs are left alone.

data.name: KeepOff
data.comment: Keep background: no area is changed.

data.name: ResetAdjustments
data.value: Back to the theme's own values
data.comment: Button that undoes the user's slider changes for the selected theme.

data.name: PercentValue
data.comment: A slider's value in per cent. {0} is the number.

data.name: MappingHeading
data.value: Colours on screen now, and what you see
data.comment: Heading of the table that maps each colour found under the lens to the colour shown.

data.name: MappingEmpty
data.value: Switch the lens on to see the colours under it.
data.comment: Shown in place of the mapping table while the lens is off or has not looked at the screen yet.

data.name: MappingFound
data.comment: Column heading: the colour found on screen.

data.name: MappingShare
data.comment: Column heading: how much of the lens the colour covers.

data.name: MappingUsedAs
data.comment: Column heading: the role the colour was given.

data.name: MappingShownAs
data.comment: Column heading: the colour the lens shows instead.

data.name: MappingColour
data.comment: A colour in the mapping table. {0} is its name ("near black"), {1} its hex value.

data.name: MappingContrast
data.comment: Contrast of a shown colour against the shown page. {0} is the ratio with one decimal.

data.name: MappingOnLight
data.comment: Under a found colour: it was found in a light part of the screen.

data.name: MappingOnDark
data.comment: Under a found colour: it was found in a dark part of the screen.

data.name: MappingPinned
data.comment: Marks a row whose role the user chose.

data.name: MappingRowName
data.value: {0}, {1} of the lens, used as {2}, shown as {3}
data.comment: One row of the mapping table as a sentence for screen readers. {0} found colour, {1} share, {2} role, {3} shown colour.

data.name: MappingRoleOf
data.comment: Name of the role list of one row, for screen readers. {0} is the found colour.

data.name: ResetMapping
data.comment: Button that removes every pinned role.

data.name: RolePage
data.comment: Role: the largest background.

data.name: RolePanel
data.comment: Role: secondary backgrounds.

data.name: RoleText
data.comment: Role: main reading text.

data.name: RoleQuietText
data.comment: Role: secondary text, borders, icons.

data.name: RoleLink
data.comment: Role: interactive accent.

data.name: RoleGood
data.comment: Role: status colour for success.

data.name: RoleWarning
data.comment: Role: status colour for warnings.

data.name: RoleBad
data.comment: Role: status colour for errors.

data.name: RoleOtherAccent
data.comment: Role: any other strong colour; keeps its hue.

data.name: HandleText
data.comment: Text on the handle of the lens. {0} is the name of the theme.

data.name: StartFailed
data.comment: Message when the lens cannot be created at start-up. {0} is the reason reported by Windows.

data.name: CloseButton
data.comment: Button that closes a message window.

data.name: UnknownOption
data.value: ThemeLens does not know the option "{0}". It understands --dev and --source pattern.
data.comment: Message for a command-line option that is not understood.
